title: Venom / Shockwave
label: Slimzos

type.basis: An early 2002 instrumental on Slimzee's label that its maker describes as an 8-bar grime track; extends the type series to South London.

sound.text: Plastician describes 'Venom' as an '8-bar' grime track, made in FruityLoops when he had little production experience.
Wikipedia describes his early work as a 'grimy take on the instrumental sound' from the darker side of UK garage (artist-level, not track-specific).

context.text: Released on Slimzos, the imprint of Rinse FM DJ Slimzee; Plasticman's first 12".
Plastician sent early tracks to Slimzee on CD via the Rhythm Division shop; Slimzee signed two of them to Slimzos and played them.
Plasticman is from Thornton Heath, in the London Borough of Croydon, South London.
Reissued digitally on 'Plasticman Remastered (Deluxe Edition)', 14 July 2014.

uncertainty: No catalogue number found. The track pairing 'Venom / Shockwave' and 'early 2002' come from Wikipedia only; Bandcamp confirms Shockwave on Slimzos in 2002. Discogs blocked, so not cross-checked.
tracklist: Two tracks, 'Venom' and 'Shockwave'. Plastician's Bandcamp says 'Shockwave' was produced in 2001 and was his first release.

audit.note: Album page shows 'Electronic · 2014' (21 songs) but no track list was visible, so presence of Venom and Shockwave is not confirmed on Apple; inferred from the Bandcamp deluxe edition track list. 2014 remastered reissue.
Not found via web searches restricted to qobuz.com (Qobuz's own catalogue search needs JS/app); absence is less certain than on Apple. Searches for Plastician returned only Plastikman.
